title: Placing the Concert Attire Package in a Fine Arts Payment Plan by Days to the Next Concert, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Concert attire package in the installment plan.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the concert attire package of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** is placed by the calendar days from its posting date to the first of the ensemble's concerts on 2026-12-10, 2027-02-11 and 2027-05-13 that falls on or after it: all of it up front when there are fewer than 14 days, 50 percent of it up front when there are 14 days or more but fewer than 28 days, and otherwise, or when no concert falls on or after its posting date, it stays in the plan total, each up-front part rounded to the nearest cent with half a cent rounding up.

The posting date is that of the latest concert attire package entry on the participation's ledger.

| Days from the posting date to the next concert | Part of the package net carried up front |
|---|---|
| 0 to 13 | all of it |
| 14 to 27 | 50 percent |
| 28 or more, or no concert remaining | none; it stays in the plan total |

## Cases before the concert of 2026-12-10 (hypothetical posting dates, package net of 33.15)

| Posted | Days | Up front |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-30 | 10 | 33.15 |
| 2026-11-26 | 14 | 50 percent: 16.575, rounded half up to 16.58 |
| 2026-11-13 | 27 | 16.58 |
| 2026-11-12 | 28 | none |
